Narrative

(SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY)
AT 0823Z, (b)(1)1.4a        TOOK OFF FROM OJMS VIA SLR. [b)(1)1.4s] PROCEEDED TO FRAGGED
TASKING.

AT 0649Z, [b)(1)1.4s] WAS 7-LINED. [b)(1)1.4s] ARRIVED ON-STATION AT 1102Z AND PERFORMED
FMV/SIGINT COLLECTION AT 37S FV 85(1)(1).8d(1)(1).(SEE ISR 1).

AT 1158Z, [b)(1)1.4s] WAS 7-LINED. [b)(1)1.4s] ARRIVED ON-STATION AT 1230Z AND PERFORMED
FMV/SIGINT COLLECTION AT 37S FU 36(1)(1).70(1)(1).(SEE ISR 2).

AT 1559Z, [b)(1)1.4s] OBSERVED AN UNIDENTIFIED ARRIEAL PHENOMENON (SEE UAP 1).

AT 2252Z, [b)(1)1.4s] WAS 7-LINED. [b)(1)1.4s] ARRIVED ON-STATION AT 2318Z AND PERFORMED
FMV/SIGINT COLLECTION AT 37S FU 85(1)(1).8d(1)(1).(SEE ISR 3).

AT 0124Z, [b)(1)1.4s] RETURNED TO BASE. AT 0447Z, [b)(1)1.4s] CONDUCTED SLR AND LANDED AT
OJMS. FULL MOTION VIDEO WAS EXPLOITED BY GET. 20:24 MISSION HOURS, 14:22 FMV
HOURS, 3X FMV TASKINGS PROSECUTED, 13:02 SIGINT HOURS, 3X SIGINT TASKINGS.
(SECRET//REL TO USA, FVEY)
